items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Yes, he used to come as a visitor and start playing with us like he was getting paid.

ctx.x: Okay. At that time, you began playing at the Royal Roost, The Club Clque and other places like that. Did Charlie Parker appear on any of those dates with you? Was he on the bill with you?
Yes, he used to come as a visitor and start playing with us like he was getting paid.
Right, because there is a recording of "Asia Minor" which was tape-recorded without your knowledege and it's on the market now; a bootleg recording of "Asia Minor" which sounds very good.
